name: perchance-generator
description: Create, validate, preview and run Perchance.ai generators with AI assistance. Supports full .perchance syntax generation, 150+ templates, local preview and live browser execution via Playwright.
author: Gzeu

tools.name: generate_perchance
tools.description: AI-generate a complete .perchance generator from a topic. Uses Groq LLaMA 3.3.

input_schema.topic: string (required) — what to generate, e.g. 'fantasy tavern names'

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List all 150+ built-in templates grouped by category.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get the full .perchance code of a specific template by name.

tools.name: validate_syntax
tools.description: Validate .perchance syntax. Returns errors and warnings.

tools.name: preview_rolls
tools.description: Preview generator results locally without a browser. Fast, no Playwright needed.

tools.name: run_on_perchance
tools.description: Run generator live on perchance.ai via Playwright. In cloud/CI environments set PERCHANCE_CLOUD_MODE=true to use headless Chromium with --no-sandbox. Falls back to preview_rolls if Playwright is unavailable.
tools.cloud_note: Requires playwright + chromium. Set PERCHANCE_CLOUD_MODE=true for Docker/CI/Vercel.
